subject: [hw] D01 census for V18: NEON three registers same length (157)
body:
D01 census (facts/census.py) over bin/vpud + lib/{libvpud_vcodec,libvcodecdrv,libvcodec_utility,libvcodec_oal}.so, read from the extracted /vendor. Method: recursive walk from every exported FUNC symbol and every .ARM.exidx entry, llvm-objdump -d --triple=thumbv8a --mattr=+neon,+vfp4,+fp-armv8,+hwdiv,+hwdiv-arm on function ranges (symbol names via --disassemble-symbols so each decode starts at its own entry), B/B<c>/CBZ/BL/BLX followed, BLX imm switches mode, TBB/TBH tables followed, literal pools and jump tables excluded from the code-byte denominator. Counts are reachable instructions only. Coverage: drv 88.3% of function-range code bytes, utility 78.1%, oal 100.1%, vpud_vcodec 67.0%, vpud 94.7%; the rest is code reachable only through computed branches (function-pointer vtables) and the 4-call lazy-fill budget per object. Full numbers in FACTS.md.
